title: Bias Ahead: Sensitive Prompts as Early Warnings for Fairness in Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Identity and Diversity bias (Gender, Sexuality, Ethnicity, Disability)
bias_targets.methodology: Manual evaluation of LLM responses to sensitive prompts for factual correctness and communicative appropriateness, identifying stereotypical associations (e.g., gendered professional roles) and lack of critical awareness.

Manual evaluation of LLM responses to sensitive prompts regarding medical conditions, mental health, and therapy to assess safety and communicative responsibility, such as checking if models normalize self-diagnosis instead of advising professional help.
Manual evaluation of LLM responses to sensitive prompts concerning beliefs, values, and ethics to assess the respectful, coherent, and contextually appropriate handling of existential dilemmas.
Manual evaluation of LLM responses to sensitive prompts about ideologies, justice, rights, and global conflicts to check for implicit ideological stances that could mislead or alienate users.
Manual evaluation of LLM responses to emotionally delicate or morally ambiguous prompts (e.g., interpersonal dynamics, grief) to assess ethical distancing and communicative awareness.
